ExampleDesign.Name: edf_base_pl
ExampleDesign.DisplayName: Versal Embedded Common Platform - Simple PL
ExampleDesign.Description:
This design is based on the Versal Embedded Common Platform – No PL and adds a very small programmable logic (PL) design.
The PL is not intended for user applications; it is included only to support creation of an EDF WIC boot image and to validate the segmented configuration boot flow.
The generated WIC image serves as a verified, known‑good Linux boot image. This same WIC image can be reused for all designs derived from the Versal Embedded Common Platform – No PL, without regeneration for Gen2 devices.
